introHtml: Custom multi function tools with zipper combine everyday utility with secure storage. The zippered closure keeps tools like knives, screwdrivers, and bottle openers organized and safe, making them ideal for safety managers distributing kits to field crews or marketing directors assembling conference giveaways. Choose from nylon or polyester cases with your logo embroidered or screen printed directly on the fabric. These branded tools offer a practical way to keep your company top of mind every time they are used.
